copy.tl: Ang ethyl alcohol, o ethanol, ay isang alcohol na may dalawang carbon atoms at matatagpuan sa mga inuming may alkohol at ginagamit bilang disinfectant.
copy.bis: Ang ethyl alcohol, o ethanol, usa ka alcohol nga adunay duha ka carbon atoms ug makita sa mga ilimnon nga may alkohol ug gigamit isip disinfectant.

copy.tl: Ang ethyne, na tinatawag ding acetylene, ay ang pinakasimpleng alkyne at ginagamit bilang panggatong sa welding dahil napakainit nito kung magliyab.
copy.bis: Ang ethyne, nga gitawag usab ug acetylene, mao ang pinakasimple nga alkyne ug gigamit isip sugnod sa welding tungod kay init kaayo kini kon mosiga.

copy.tl: Maaga sa gabi, ang grupo ng mga bituin na Orion ay mababa pa sa langit, malapit sa silangang horizon.
copy.bis: Sayo sa gabii, ang grupo sa mga bituon nga Orion ubos pa sa langit, duol sa silangang horizon.

copy.en: Common household examples of solutions include soda, vinegar, and wine, which all look like single liquids even though they contain several substances.
copy.tl: Ang mga karaniwang halimbawa ng solution sa bahay ay ang soda, suka, at wine, na lahat ay mukhang iisang likido kahit naglalaman ng iba't ibang sangkap.
copy.bis: Ang sagad nga mga pananglitan sa solution sa balay mao ang soda, suka, ug wine, nga tanang mora og usa ra ka likido bisan pa nga adunay lain-laing mga sangkap.

copy.tl: Ipinapaliwanag ng mga teorya ng evolution kung paano nagkakaroon ang mga organismo ng mga katangian sa maraming henerasyon na tumutulong sa kanila na mabuhay kapag nagbabago ang kapaligiran, tulad ng mas makapal na balahibo sa malamig na lugar.
copy.bis: Ang mga teorya sa evolution nagpatin-aw kon sa unsang paagi ang mga organismo makabaton og mga kinaiya sa daghang henerasyon nga makatabang nila nga mabuhi kon mag-usab ang kalikopan, sama sa mas baga nga balhibo sa bugnaw nga lugar.

copy.tl: Ang sodium chloride, o table salt, at calcium carbonate, na matatagpuan sa chalk, ay mga karaniwang halimbawa ng mga asin.
copy.bis: Ang sodium chloride, o table salt, ug calcium carbonate, nga makita sa chalk, mao ang kasagarang mga pananglitan sa mga asin.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe a valence electron as an electron in the outer shell of an atom that can take part in formation of bonds
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses exercise and heart rate, a physiology/health topic. G9-M-3 requires describing valence electrons in the outer shell of an atom and their role in bond formation, which is chemistry. There is no connection between the card content and the competency.

copy.en: Physical activity increases heart rate, which you can feel as a faster pulse at your wrist.
copy.tl: Ang physical activity ay nagpapabilis ng heart rate, na mararamdaman mo bilang mas mabilis na pulse sa iyong pulso.
copy.bis: Ang physical activity nagpapaspas sa heart rate, nga mabati nimo isip mas paspas nga pulse sa imong pulso.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Exercise makes your cells, tissues, organs, and organ systems work better
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the chemical properties of materials, such as they can be burnt, react with other materials, or are degradable or biodegradable
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses exercise and biological organization (cells, tissues, organs, organ systems), which is biology content. copy.en:
Why does daily exercise help all levels of biological organization?

Exercise makes your cells, tissues, organs, and organ systems work better, which keeps your whole organism strong and healthy!
copy.tl:
Bakit nakakatulong ang araw-araw na ehersisyo sa lahat ng levels ng biological organization?

Ang ehersisyo ay nagpapaganda ng trabaho ng iyong cells, tissues, organs, at organ systems, na nagpapanatiling malakas at malusog ang iyong buong organism!
copy.bis:
Ngano man nga ang adlaw-adlaw nga ehersisyo makatabang sa tanang levels sa biological organization?

Ang ehersisyo nagpauswag sa trabaho sa imong cells, tissues, organs, ug organ systems, nga nagpabiling kusgan ug himsog ang imong tibuok organism!

assignedReviews.reason: The card is about exercise improving sleep quality. It does not describe how any of the human body systems (muscular, skeletal, digestive, circulatory, respiratory) work, nor does it provide information needed to perform that competency.

copy.en: Exercising during the day helps you sleep more soundly at night.
copy.tl: Ang pag-eehersisyo sa araw ay tumutulong para mas mahimbing kang makatulog sa gabi.
copy.bis: Ang pag-ehersisyo sa adlaw makatabang aron mas maayo kang makatulog sa gabii.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: What is the difference between expanded and condensed structural formulas?
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: observe and identify sources and uses of light, sound, and heat energy at school, at home and in the local community
assignedReviews.reason: The card teaches expanded vs condensed structural formulas in chemistry. It has no relation to sources and uses of light, sound, or heat energy.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: What is the difference between expanded and condensed structural formulas?
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify that waves carry energy from a source to a receiver
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about chemical formula notation, not about waves carrying energy from a source to a receiver.

copy.en:
What is the difference between expanded and condensed structural formulas?

An expanded formula draws every bond, while a condensed formula omits some bonds to fit on one line, like CH3CH2CH3 for propane.
copy.tl:
Ano ang pagkakaiba ng expanded at condensed structural formulas?

Iginuguhit ng expanded formula ang bawat bond, habang ang condensed formula ay nag-aalis ng ilang bonds para magkasya sa isang linya, tulad ng CH3CH2CH3 para sa propane.
copy.bis:
Unsa ang kalainan tali sa expanded ug condensed structural formulas?

Ang expanded formula nagdrowing sa matag bond, samtang ang condensed formula nagwagtang sa pipila ka bonds aron masigo sa usa ka linya, sama sa CH3CH2CH3 para sa propane.

copy.en: The expiration date on a package tells you exactly when the food is expected to stay fresh and safe!
copy.tl: Ang expiration date sa pakete ay nagsasabi kung hanggang kailan inaasahang sariwa at ligtas ang pagkain!
copy.bis: Ang expiration date sa pakete nagsulti kung hangtod kanus-a gilauman nga preska ug luwas pa ang pagkaon!

assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses extending clothing life to reduce environmental footprints, which has no connection to DNA, genes, chromosomes, or trait transmission. The assigned competency is about genetics, so the tag is unrelated.

copy.en: Extending the life of clothes by just three months reduces their carbon, water, and waste footprints by five to ten percent.
copy.tl: Ang pagpapahaba ng buhay ng mga damit ng tatlong buwan lamang ay nakakabawas ng kanilang carbon, water, at waste footprints ng lima hanggang sampung porsyento.
copy.bis: Ang pagpalugway sa kinabuhi sa mga sinina ug tulo lang ka bulan makapakunhod sa ilang carbon, water, ug waste footprints ug lima ngadto sa napulo ka porsyento.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: it's your brain that makes sense of them
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the characteristics of living things: they grow, respond, and reproduce
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses vision and the brain's role in interpreting signals. It does not address the characteristics of living things (grow, respond, reproduce) at all.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: it's your brain that makes sense of them
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe in simple terms how the following human body systems work: muscular, skeletal, digestive, circulatory, and respiratory
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about the brain and vision, not about the muscular, skeletal, digestive, circulatory, or respiratory systems. The brain is not one of the systems listed in this competency.

copy.en:
What organ actually lets you see?

Your eyes send signals, but it's your brain that makes sense of them — so in a way, you really see with your brain!
copy.tl:
Ano talaga ang gumagawa para makakita tayo?

Nagpapadala ng senyales ang mata, pero ang utak ang nagbibigay kahulugan dito — kaya masasabing sa utak talaga tayo nakakakita!
copy.bis:
Unsa gyud ang naghimo nga makakita ta?

Nagpadala og senyales ang mata, apan ang utok ang naghubad niini — mao nga sa utok gyud kita makakita!

copy.tl: Ang temperatura, paghalo, laki ng particle, uri ng solute, at dami ng solvent ay nakakaapekto kung gaano kabilis matunaw ang solute.
copy.bis: Ang temperatura, pagpalihok, gidak-on sa particle, kinaiya sa solute, ug gidaghanon sa solvent makaapekto kung unsa kapaspas matunaw ang solute.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A fair test changes only one factor at a time
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: demonstrate various techniques in separating mixtures, such as decantation, winnowing, scooping, picking, evaporation, filtering, sieving, and using magnets
assignedReviews.reason: The card teaches the fair-test rule (changing one factor at a time), which is unrelated to the competency G6-M-6 about demonstrating mixture separation techniques such as decantation, filtering, and sieving.

copy.en:
What makes an experiment a fair test?

A fair test changes only one factor at a time, so you know exactly which change caused the result!
copy.tl:
Ano ang gumagawa sa isang experiment na maging fair test?

Ang fair test ay nagbabago lamang ng isang factor sa bawat pagkakataon, kaya alam mo kung aling pagbabago ang sanhi ng resulta!
copy.bis:
Unsa ang naghimo sa usa ka experiment nga fair test?

Ang fair test mag-usab lamang og usa ka factor matag higayon, mao nga kahibalo ka kung unsang pagbag-o ang hinungdan sa resulta!

copy.en: Families should create an evacuation plan that includes a meeting place, a route to higher ground, and important contact numbers.
copy.tl: Dapat gumawa ang bawat pamilya ng evacuation plan na may meeting place, ruta papunta sa mataas na lugar, at mahahalagang contact number.
copy.bis: Ang matag pamilya kinahanglang maghimo ug evacuation plan nga adunay meeting place, ruta padulong sa taas nga lugar, ug importanteng contact number.

assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe homeostasis as a state of balance among all the body systems in humans that needs to be maintained for survival and proper functioning; its indicators include body temperature, glucose level, and blood pressure
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about plant propagation, not human homeostasis, body systems, or indicators like temperature, glucose, or blood pressure. It is unrelated to G10-L-1.

copy.en: Farmers and gardeners choose between seeds and methods like cuttings or grafting to grow crops faster, keep good traits, or create new plant varieties.
copy.tl: Pinipili ng mga magsasaka at hardinero ang pagitan ng buto at mga paraan tulad ng cuttings o grafting upang mapabilis ang pagpapatubo ng mga pananim, mapanatili ang magagandang katangian, o makalikha ng mga bagong variety ng halaman.
copy.bis: Ang mga mag-uuma ug hardinero mipili tali sa mga liso ug mga paagi sama sa cuttings o grafting aron mapadali ang pagpatubo sa mga tanom, mapadayon ang maayong mga kinaiya, o makahimo og bag-ong mga variety sa tanom.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A fault is a fracture or break between two blocks of rock in Earth's crust
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: demonstrate through guided investigation the advantages and limitations of simple machines, such as inclined planes, wedges, levers, and pulleys
assignedReviews.reason: The card defines a geological fault, which is unrelated to simple machines (inclined planes, wedges, levers, pulleys) that G6-F-2 addresses. No instructional support for the competency.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A fault is a fracture or break between two blocks of rock in Earth's crust
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: observe and describe examples and uses of simple machines found at home, at school, and in the community
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about a fault in Earth's crust, not about examples and uses of simple machines at home, school, or community. Completely unrelated to the competency.

copy.en: A fault is a fracture or break between two blocks of rock in Earth's crust, formed when stress from inside Earth becomes too great.
copy.tl: Ang fault ay isang fracture o bitak sa pagitan ng dalawang bloke ng bato sa crust ng Earth, na nabubuo kapag sobra na ang stress mula sa loob ng Earth.
copy.bis: Ang fault usa ka fracture o liki tali sa duha ka bloke sa bato sa crust sa Earth, nga maporma kon sobra na ang stress nga gikan sa ilawom sa Earth.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Farm animals and pets need to be fed regularly by people

copy.tl: Ang mga farm animals at alagang hayop ay kailangang regular na pakainin ng mga tao, dahil hindi nila laging kayang maghanap ng sariling pagkain tulad ng ginagawa ng mga ligaw na hayop.
copy.bis: Ang mga farm animals ug binuhi nga mga mananap kinahanglan regular nga pakan-on sa mga tawo, kay dili sila kanunay makapangita sa ilang kaugalingong pagkaon sama sa gibuhat sa mga ihalas nga mananap.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Ferns growing on tree branches

assignedReviews.reason: The card describes a commensal relationship between ferns and trees, with no mention of life cycles, birth, egg, seed, or maturation stages. It does not support comparing life cycles of mammals, birds, or plants.

copy.en: Ferns growing on tree branches get more sunlight and air, while the tree is neither harmed nor helped by their presence.
copy.tl: Ang mga pako na tumutubo sa mga sanga ng puno ay nakakakuha ng mas maraming sikat ng araw at hangin, habang ang puno ay hindi nasasaktan at hindi rin natutulungan ng kanilang presensya.
copy.bis: Ang mga pako nga motubo sa mga sanga sa kahoy makakuha ug mas daghang silaw sa adlaw ug hangin, samtang ang kahoy dili masakitan ug wala usab matabangi sa ilang presensya.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Fertilization may take place during the ovulation phase
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the structures, movements and events that occur at each type of plate boundary
assignedReviews.reason: The card explains when fertilization occurs in the human reproductive system. G10-E-2 requires describing structures, movements, and events at plate boundaries. The content is entirely unrelated to plate tectonics.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Fertilization may take place during the ovulation phase
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the types of plate boundaries found around the Earth
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses fertilization timing during ovulation. G9-E-3 requires describing types of plate boundaries. No connection exists between the card content and the competency.

copy.en:
When can fertilization happen?

Fertilization may take place during the ovulation phase while the egg is in the fallopian tube.
copy.tl:
Kailan maaaring mangyari ang fertilization?

Maaaring maganap ang fertilization sa ovulation phase habang ang itlog ay nasa fallopian tube.
copy.bis:
Kanus-a mahitabo ang fertilization?

Mahitabo ang fertilization sa ovulation phase samtang ang itlog naa sa fallopian tube.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A key characteristic of simple machines is that they have few or no moving parts

copy.en: Simple machines have few or no moving parts, which is why they are called simple.
copy.tl: Ang simple machines ay may kakaunti o walang gumagalaw na bahagi, kaya tinawag silang simple.
copy.bis: Ang simple machines adunay diyutay o walay naglihok nga mga parte, mao nga gitawag kini nga simple.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Seek shade and avoid direct sunlight during peak hours, usually around noon, to protect yourself from the sun's harmful effects.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain how homeostasis is maintained through various feedback mechanisms, both positive and negative
assignedReviews.reason: The card gives sun-safety advice (seeking shade) and does not explain homeostasis or any positive/negative feedback mechanism. It is unrelated to the competency's subject matter.

copy.en: Seek shade and avoid direct sunlight during peak hours, usually around noon, to protect yourself from the sun's harmful effects.
copy.tl: Humanap ng lilim at iwasan ang direktang sikat ng araw tuwing peak hours, kadalasan bandang tanghali, para maprotektahan ang sarili mula sa masamang epekto ng araw.
copy.bis: Pangita og landong ug likayi ang direktang kahayag sa adlaw panahon sa peak hours, kasagara sa udto, aron mapanalipdan ang kaugalingon batok sa makadaot nga epekto sa adlaw.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: If a bottle is 40% alcohol, in 100 milliliters of it, 40 milliliters are the alcohol solute!
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe that particles are constantly in motion, have spaces between them, attract each other, and move faster as the temperature increases (or with the addition of heat)
assignedReviews.reason: The card teaches percent concentration to find solute amount. It says nothing about particle motion, spacing, attraction, or temperature effects on particle speed.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: If a bottle is 40% alcohol, in 100 milliliters of it, 40 milliliters are the alcohol solute!
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain the difference between heat and temperature
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about solution concentration, not about the difference between heat and temperature. No heat or temperature concept is addressed.

copy.en:
How can percent concentration help us find the amount of solute?

If a bottle is 40% alcohol, in 100 milliliters of it, 40 milliliters are the alcohol solute!
copy.tl:
Paano nakakatulong ang percent concentration para malaman ang dami ng solute?

Kung ang bote ay 40% alcohol, sa 100 milliliters nito, 40 milliliters ang alcohol na solute!
copy.bis:
Unsaon pagtabang sa percent concentration aron mahibaloan ang gidaghanon sa solute?

Kung ang botelya 40% alcohol, sa 100 milliliters niini, 40 milliliters ang alcohol nga solute!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: You can find the voltage drop across any single resistor in a series circuit by multiplying its resistance by the current flowing through it, using V=IR.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain how solar energy contributes to the occurrence of land and sea breezes, monsoons, and the Intertropical Convergence Zone (ITCZ)
assignedReviews.reason: The card teaches Ohm's law for voltage drop in a series circuit, which is a physics/electricity topic. G7-E-12 concerns solar energy and atmospheric phenomena (land/sea breezes, monsoons, ITCZ). There is no connection to the competency.

copy.en: You can find the voltage drop across any single resistor in a series circuit by multiplying its resistance by the current flowing through it, using V=IR.
copy.tl: Mahahanap mo ang voltage drop sa kahit anong resistor sa series circuit sa pamamagitan ng pag-multiply ng resistance nito sa current na dumadaloy dito, gamit ang V=IR.
copy.bis: Makita nimo ang voltage drop sa bisan unsang resistor sa series circuit pinaagi sa pag-multiply sa iyang resistance sa current nga moagi niini, gamit ang V=IR.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: They look at tiny details called minutiae
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe different science process skills used in performing simple science activities, such as observing, predicting, and measuring using units such as millimeter, centimeter, and meter
assignedReviews.reason: The card explains how experts match fingerprints using ridge minutiae. It does not describe any science process skills (observing, predicting, measuring) nor use units such as millimeter, centimeter, or meter. The content is unrelated to the competency.

copy.en:
How do experts match fingerprints?

They look at tiny details called minutiae — like where a ridge ends or splits in two. Matching these points proves the prints are the same.
copy.tl:
Paano tinitiyak ng eksperto ang tugmang fingerprint?

Tinitingnan nila ang maliliit na detalye na tinatawag minutiae — kung saan nagtatapos o nahahati ang isang linya. Ang tugma ng mga puntong ito ang nagpapatunay na magkapareho.
copy.bis:
Unsaon pagtukod sa eksperto nga parehas ang fingerprint?

Tan-awon nila ang gagmayng detalye nga gitawag minutiae — asa matapos o mabahin ang linya. Ang pagtugma niini nga mga punto ang nagpamatuod nga parehas.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: They used fire beacons - big fires on hills - and smoke signals
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: make a Sun-Earth-Moon system model to demonstrate and explain the observable effects of predictable patterns and events including changes in seasons, changes observed in the patterns of visible star over a year, and solar and lunar eclipses
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes historical fire and smoke signaling for communication. It contains no content about the Sun-Earth-Moon system, seasons, star patterns, or eclipses, which are the focus of G6-E-8.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: They used fire beacons - big fires on hills - and smoke signals
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: participate in guided activities to carefully observe and describe the natural objects commonly seen in the sky during daytime and nighttime, including the Sun, the Moon, planets, and stars
assignedReviews.reason: The card does not discuss natural objects in the sky such as the Sun, Moon, planets, or stars. It is about human-made fire and smoke signals, unrelated to observing celestial objects.

copy.en:
How did people send messages before phones?

They used fire beacons - big fires on hills - and smoke signals - puffs of smoke rising into the sky - to warn others or call for help from far away.
copy.tl:
Paano nagpadala ng mensahe ang mga tao noong wala pang telepono?

Gumamit sila ng fire beacons - malalaking apoy sa mga burol - at smoke signals - mga buga ng usok na tumataas sa langit - para magbabala o humingi ng tulong mula sa malayo.
copy.bis:
Giunsa pagpadala sa mga tawo og mensahe sa wala pay telepono?

Gigamit nila ang fire beacons - dagkong kalayo sa mga bungtod - ug smoke signals - mga buga sa aso nga mosaka sa langit - aron magpasidaan o mangayo og tabang gikan sa layo.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: When a sperm and egg fuse during fertilization
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: differentiate the subatomic particles protons, neutrons, and electrons in terms of their symbol, mass, charge, and location within an atom
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes zygote formation during fertilization, a biology topic. G8-M-3 requires differentiating subatomic particles (protons, neutrons, electrons) in terms of symbol, mass, charge, and location. There is no instructional support for this chemistry competency.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: When a sperm and egg fuse during fertilization
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: write the chemical formula and chemical name of some common covalent compounds, including water (H2O), carbon dioxide (CO2), and ammonia (NH3)
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about fertilization and zygote formation, not about writing chemical formulas or names of covalent compounds such as water, carbon dioxide, or ammonia. No connection to G9-M-8.

copy.en: When a sperm and egg fuse during fertilization, they form a zygote, the first cell of a new organism with genetic material from both parents.
copy.tl: Kapag nagsama ang sperm at egg sa fertilization, bumubuo sila ng zygote, ang unang cell ng bagong organismo na may genetic material mula sa parehong magulang.
copy.bis: Kon mag-uban ang sperm ug egg sa fertilization, magporma sila ug zygote, ang unang cell sa bag-ong organismo nga adunay genetic material gikan sa duha ka ginikanan.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The earliest primates evolved from other mammals in the early Paleogene Period
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify advantageous and disadvantageous examples of conduction, convection, and radiation
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses primate evolution and the origin of the genus Homo, which is a biology/evolution topic. G7-F-9 requires identifying advantageous and disadvantageous examples of conduction, convection, and radiation (heat transfer). There is no connection to heat transfer or any physics content.

copy.en: The earliest primates evolved from other mammals in the early Paleogene Period, eventually leading to the genus Homo.
copy.tl: Ang mga pinakaunang primate ay nag-ebolb mula sa ibang mga mammal noong unang bahagi ng Paleogene Period, na kalaunan ay humantong sa genus na Homo.
copy.bis: Ang labing unang mga primate nag-evolve gikan sa uban pang mga mammal sa sayong Paleogene Period, nga sa ulahi misangpot sa genus nga Homo.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: What are the five steps of digestion?
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: observe and identify sources and uses of light, sound, and heat energy at school, at home and in the local community
assignedReviews.reason: The card teaches the five steps of digestion (ingestion, propulsion, digestion, absorption, defecation), which is a biology topic. G4-F-10 is about identifying sources and uses of light, sound, and heat energy. There is no connection to energy sources or uses.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: What are the five steps of digestion?
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify that energy is something that can cause change including light, sound, and heat energy
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about the digestion process, not about energy as something that can cause change (light, sound, heat). The content is entirely unrelated to the competency.

copy.en:
What are the five steps of digestion?

Ingestion, propulsion, digestion, absorption, and defecation — taking in food, moving it, breaking it down, absorbing nutrients, and removing waste.
copy.tl:
Ano ang limang hakbang ng digestion?

Ingestion, propulsion, digestion, absorption, at defecation — pagpasok ng pagkain, paggalaw nito, pagtunaw, pagsipsip ng nutrients, at paglabas ng dumi.
copy.bis:
Unsa ang lima ka lakang sa digestion?

Ingestion, propulsion, digestion, absorption, ug defecation — pagsulod sa pagkaon, paglihok nito, pagtunaw, pagsuyop sa nutrients, ug pagpagawas sa hugaw.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: It means the material can easily catch fire when it touches a spark or flame, and it burns quickly!
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the process of photosynthesis and respiration, and identify its raw materials needed and products
assignedReviews.reason: The card defines flammability, a chemical property of materials. G8-L-9 requires describing photosynthesis and respiration and their raw materials and products. There is no connection to these biological processes.

copy.en: Gasoline, alcohol, acetone, thinner, and oil are flammable materials because they can catch fire very easily.
copy.tl: Ang gasolina, alcohol, acetone, thinner, at oil ay mga flammable na materyales dahil napakadali nilang magliyab.
copy.bis: Ang gasolina, alcohol, acetone, thinner, ug oil kay mga flammable nga materyales tungod kay dali ra kaayo sila mosiga.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A flat iron transforms electrical energy into heat energy
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify from pictures and diagrams the parts of the respiratory system as the nose, windpipe, and lungs, and describe how they work
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about energy transformation in a flat iron, not about the respiratory system (nose, windpipe, lungs). No instructional support for G5-L-2.

copy.en: A flat iron transforms electrical energy into heat energy, and doing all the ironing work once a week helps conserve energy.
copy.tl: Ang flat iron ay ginagawang heat energy ang electrical energy, at ang pagpaplantsa ng lahat ng damit minsan sa isang linggo ay nakakatipid ng energy.
copy.bis: Ang flat iron nag-usab sa electrical energy ngadto sa heat energy, ug ang pagplantsa sa tanang sinina kausa sa usa ka semana makatabang sa pagdaginot og energy.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: They were called flea glasses because people used them to study small insects like fleas!
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explore and describe how sound is made and transferred in everyday situations, such as the ringing of a bell or the hearing of noises
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about the historical name of simple microscopes (flea glasses) used to study small insects. It has no connection to sound production or transfer, which is the subject of G3-F-4.

copy.en:
What were the first simple microscopes called?

They were called flea glasses because people used them to study small insects like fleas!
copy.tl:
Ano ang tawag sa mga unang simple microscope?

Tinawag silang flea glasses dahil ginagamit ito ng mga tao para pag-aralan ang maliliit na insekto tulad ng mga pulgas!
copy.bis:
Unsa ang tawag sa mga unang simple microscope?

Gitawag sila ug flea glasses tungod kay gigamit kini sa mga tawo sa pagtuon sa gagmay nga mga insekto sama sa mga pulgas!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Floss is a special thread used to remove food and dirt stuck between your teeth.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify from pictures and labeled diagrams the parts of the digestive system as mouth, gullet, stomach, small intestine, and large intestine, and describe how they work
assignedReviews.reason: The card explains the purpose of dental floss, which is oral hygiene, not the identification or function of digestive system parts (mouth, gullet, stomach, small intestine, large intestine). It does not support the competency.

copy.en:
What is floss for?

Floss is a special thread used to remove food and dirt stuck between your teeth.
copy.tl:
Para saan ang floss?

Ang floss ay espesyal na sinulid na ginagamit para alisin ang dumi at pagkaing naiipon sa pagitan ng ngipin.
copy.bis:
Para asa ang floss?

Ang floss usa ka pinasahi nga hilo nga gigamit sa pagkuha sa hugaw ug pagkaon nga nasangit sa tunga-tunga sa ngipon.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Flowing water is water that moves
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain why ancient human cultures relied on constellations to indicate directions and verify seasons
assignedReviews.reason: The card defines flowing water and gives examples (river, faucet). It contains no information about constellations, directions, seasons, or ancient cultures, so it does not support the competency in any way.

copy.en:
What is flowing water?

Flowing water is water that moves, like a river or water from a faucet.
copy.tl:
Ano ang flowing water?

Ang flowing water ay tubig na gumagalaw, tulad ng ilog o tubig mula sa gripo.
copy.bis:
Unsa ang flowing water?

Ang flowing water mao ang tubig nga naglihok, sama sa suba o tubig nga nag-agay sa gripo.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: fluorescent lamps use less electrical energy to make the same amount of light
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify from pictures and diagrams the parts of the respiratory system as the nose, windpipe, and lungs, and describe how they work
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses energy conservation with fluorescent lamps, which is unrelated to identifying parts of the respiratory system and describing how they work.

copy.en:
Why should we use fluorescent lamps instead of incandescent bulbs?

Because fluorescent lamps use less electrical energy to make the same amount of light, so using them instead of incandescent bulbs conserves energy!
copy.tl:
Bakit dapat tayong gumamit ng fluorescent lamp imbes na incandescent bulb?

Dahil ang fluorescent lamp ay gumagamit ng mas kaunting electrical energy para makagawa ng parehong liwanag, kaya nakakatipid ito ng energy!
copy.bis:
Nganong mogamit man kita og fluorescent lamp imbes nga incandescent bulb?

Tungod kay ang fluorescent lamp mogamit og mas diyutay nga electrical energy para makahimo og parehong kahayag, mao nga makatipid kini og energy!

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Two fluorine atoms share one electron pair to form fluorine gas
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: design and construct a simple electrical circuit to identify what materials will conduct electricity and use it to identify materials from the environment that will and will not conduct electricity
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes covalent bonding in fluorine gas, which is chemistry content. G5-F-9 is about designing and constructing simple electrical circuits to test conductivity. There is no connection to circuits, conductors, or insulators.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Two fluorine atoms share one electron pair to form fluorine gas
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify advantageous and disadvantageous examples of conduction, convection, and radiation
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes covalent bonding in fluorine gas, which is chemistry content. G7-F-9 is about identifying advantageous and disadvantageous examples of conduction, convection, and radiation (heat transfer). There is no connection to heat transfer.

copy.en: Two fluorine atoms share one electron pair to form fluorine gas, and each fluorine atom is left with three lone pairs of electrons.
copy.tl: Ang dalawang fluorine atom ay nagshe-share ng isang pares ng electron para bumuo ng fluorine gas, at ang bawat fluorine atom ay may natitirang tatlong lone pairs ng electron.
copy.bis: Ang duha ka fluorine atom nagshare og usa ka pares sa electron aron maporma ang fluorine gas, ug ang matag fluorine atom adunay nahabilin nga tulo ka lone pairs sa electron.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: focal point of a curved mirror
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explore and describe how sound is made and transferred in everyday situations, such as the ringing of a bell or the hearing of noises
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses the focal point and focal length of a curved mirror, which is an optics concept. G3-F-4 is about how sound is made and transferred; there is no sound content or support for that competency.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: focal point of a curved mirror
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the physical properties of solid materials, such as hard, shiny, or stretchable
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about mirror optics, not the physical properties of solid materials such as hardness, shininess, or stretchability. No connection to G3-M-5.

copy.en:
Where is the focal point of a curved mirror?

It is exactly midway between the vertex and the center of curvature, so the focal length is half the radius of curvature.
copy.tl:
Saan matatagpuan ang focal point ng curved mirror?

Eksakto itong nasa gitna ng vertex at center of curvature, kaya ang focal length ay kalahati ng radius of curvature.
copy.bis:
Asa makit-an ang focal point sa curved mirror?

Anaa kini sa tunga-tunga sa vertex ug center of curvature, busa ang focal length katunga sa radius of curvature.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: When you fold a piece of paper, its size and shape change, and this affects how it falls.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: use models to investigate elastic or inelastic collisions and describe the forces involved and their effects
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes how folding paper changes its falling behavior; it does not involve collisions, models of elastic/inelastic collisions, or forces in collisions. The competency is about collision types and their forces, which is unrelated to the card's content.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: When you fold a piece of paper, its size and shape change, and this affects how it falls.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe different types of collisions as elastic or inelastic by providing some examples
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about the effect of shape on falling, not about describing elastic or inelastic collisions with examples. No collision concept is present, so the card does not support this competency.

copy.en: When you fold a piece of paper, its size and shape change, and this affects how it falls.
copy.tl: Kapag tinupi mo ang isang piraso ng papel, nagbabago ang sukat at hugis nito, at nakakaapekto ito sa kung paano ito bumabagsak.
copy.bis: Kon pil-on nimo ang usa ka piraso sa papel, mausab ang gidak-on ug porma kini, ug makaapekto kini sa pagkahulog.
